# Sparkfare

> Sparkfare tracks international round-trip fares from 22 US airports and judges each against that route's trailing 30-day median. Sparkfare does not sell or book travel.

## Core Resources

- [How Sparkfare Works](https://sparkfare.com/how-it-works): Deal-scoring methodology, 30-day median baseline calculation, 15% deal floor, and freshness guardrails.
- [Price Checker](https://sparkfare.com/check): Compare a round-trip price you were quoted with Sparkfare's 30-day median for that route, for routes from 22 US airports to 40 international destinations that have enough history.
- [Time-Off and Long Weekend Planner](https://sparkfare.com/time-off): Optimize 2026 and 2027 paid time off around official US federal holidays and weekends.
